# Supergraph for AI Coding Agents
> Tiếng Việt · Installation Guide · Workflow Examples · Team Setup
**Turn AI coding agents from code generators into disciplined engineering workflow systems.**
Supergraph enforces planning, TDD, verification, review, and architecture-aware decision making thro
ugh mandatory workflows, graph intelligence, and LSP-powered code analysis across Claude Code, OpenA
I Codex CLI, Google Antigravity, OpenCode, and DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
## What Supergraph Does
Every non-trivial change follows the strict engineering lifecycle:
`scan → analyze → plan → TDD → execute → fix → verify → review`
- **Knowledge Graph & Code Intelligence**: Powered by Codebase Memory MCP (`>= 0.10.8,<0.11.0`). Ind
exes repository state locally into `.codebase-memory/graph.db.zst` (cache in `~/.cache/codebase-memo
ry-mcp`) via `index_repository`, providing mathematical blast radius, call hierarchy, dependency cyc

les, and test gaps. Serena provides LSP-level symbol navigation and diagnostics.
- **7-Subagent Spec
ialized Architecture**: Autonomous separation of concerns — `plan-writer` (planning), `plan-reviewer
` (spec checks), `executor` (TDD execution), `qa-tester` (E2E browser/API testing), `security-audito
r` (OWASP/Vibesec AppSec), `diagnostician` (root-cause debugging), and `code-reviewer` (independent

merge verdict).
- **Autonomous Human Browser Agent & QA (`browser-agent`)**: Native Rust CDP (`agent
-browser`, zero Playwright). Uses compact accessibility tree snapshots (`@ref`), bypasses anti-bot w
alls via real user profiles, generates 5-dimension ISTQB test matrices (UI + API + DB fault injectio

n), and exports structured bug reports.
- **Unified Mobile Automation & Real Device QA (`mobile-agen
t`)**: Direct native REST control for iOS (via Appium `WebDriverAgent` / port 8100) and Android (via
Appium `UiAutomator2 Server` / port 6790) without heavy Appium middleware. Generates compact token-
efficient accessibility trees (`@ref`), handles hardware keys/back button, soft keyboards, permissio

n dialogs, delta snapshots, and real device screenshots.
- **Multi-Agent Orchestration (`supergraph-
team`)**: Wave DAG task scheduling with isolated Git worktrees and live dashboard (`:3333`).

### Windows Hook Behavior
On Windows, `hooks/run-hook.cmd` dynamically resolves Git Bash across stan
dard and user-level paths. If Git Bash is not found, hooks skipped with a warning, keeping platform
execution non-blocking.
